html2pdf.js 0.14.0 is bundled locally to generate document PDFs without sending
member or financial data to a conversion service.

Source: https://github.com/eKoopmans/html2pdf.js
Distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/html2pdf.js@0.14.0/dist/html2pdf.bundle.min.js

`html2pdf.LICENSE` covers html2pdf.js. The accompanying
`html2pdf.bundle.min.js.LICENSE.txt` preserves the bundled dependencies' notices.
